items.statement: Identify the molecular objects, preserve intended partner covalent identities, and document geometry/stationary-point validation and conformer coverage.
items.expected: Object identity, stoichiometry, candidate counts, deduplication/advancement and stopping are documented. A covalently rearranged minimum is not the target noncovalent association even if its frequencies are real.

items.statement: Report the computed Tb·Pa control interaction energy and audit its correspondence to the source control labelled Hex-Tb-Pa.
items.expected: Report the numerical energy, validated identities and fragment/solvent convention. Do not assert exact correspondence to the source's -16.5 kJ/mol control while the Hex-model definition remains unresolved.

items.statement: SI Fig35b defines Pa association with the C8-IL·Tb host, not total assembly from four isolated molecular components.
items.expected: Report E(C8IL.Tb.Pa)-E(C8IL.Tb)-E(Pa), validated partner identities and the explicit relaxed/frozen/BSSE convention. The ion pair and Tb stay together in the host reference; source-definition ambiguity is disclosed rather than silently chosen to match the target.
